contract.scope: KnowledgeSource supporting relation; additional necessary condition, never IAM or a legal entitlement engine
contract.metadata_policy: Declared Source/Item catalog metadata may be projected only after existing resource/ownership/target policy. It confers no rights to body, source locators or protected snippets. Platform Support is metadata-only. No license label implies a right.
contract.body_policy: Exactly one non-revoked, effective matching attested row per act and exact source/artifact/package/audience/environment. Missing, unknown, contradictory, ambiguous or unverified evidence denies. Each source pack dependency must independently pass existing pack access and an exact rights row. No wildcard hash, edition, environment, tenant or act.
contract.edition_binding: edition_ref is explicit evidence metadata for the exact content_hash and optional exact package version; caller cannot substitute edition. Distinct active edition refs for the same requested tuple are ambiguous and denied.

proof_format.binding_hash: SHA256 canonical JSON of exact_scope + evidence effective interval, authorization id; never license_classification
proof_format.authority: Actual rights holder or competent authority identified by evidence, not generated by Codex
proof_format.basis: Original/editorial authorship declaration, tenant authority declaration or third-party actual license/legal basis, stated and verified during future governed materialization
proof_format.evidence_locator: Reference to actual legal evidence, not a URL fetched by clients or the rights evaluator
proof_format.evidence_sha256: Hash of the actual supporting legal evidence; attestation hash is separately evidence_hash

contract.custody: Existing private encrypted/versioned MinIO service, same bucket authority; new internal key namespace knowledge-rights/<right-id>/<uuidv7>.json. Immutable version-specific key/ref/hash; no FileObject global tenant surrogate, public URLs or network URL fetch. Max attestation bytes 65536. No upload API is added. Real evidence acquisition/materialization is separately authorized.
contract.preliminary: Reuse NON_AUTHORITATIVE_TEST_PACK and existing validation-provenance/access. Development/test/qa may perform only specifically evidenced acts. Production and official pack use remain denied for NON_AUTHORITATIVE_TEST_PACK. No new preliminary lifecycle state. No automatic homologation of 211/104/six crosswalks.
contract.api_compatibility: No new routes, API bodies, IAM permissions, grants, registry transition or workflow states. Existing 30 operations and predecessor B06/Item amendments retained. Rights maintenance is not exposed or activated.
contract.audit: Use canonical AuditEvent/outbox/idempotency, source aggregate and actual actor. Future materialization must record audit.knowledge.knowledge_source.rights.record.v1; revocation audit.knowledge.knowledge_source.rights.revoke.v1. Audit payload contains right id, binding/evidence hashes, source/package refs and rationale, no legal body. No parallel audit log. No write/import/registry activation in this publication.
contract.temporal: effective_from <= statement timestamp < effective_to; revoked_at<=timestamp denies current use. Grant facts and evidence immutable. Revocation is one-time monotonic, with canonical audit ref; never edits prior audit or publication. No cached permit or historical retrospective license assertion.
contract.runtime_adoption: No new runtime feature flag. Composition remains unregistered until separately authorized physical/schema, rights evidence, IAM, registry and deployment gates. Builders/hooks may be tested in isolation. Existing routes retain existing authority.

knowledge_binding.source_null_pack_dependency: Included in the same internal operation; no synthetic evidence row required

internalPolicy.rights: No declaration or attestation is fabricated. This policy changes no legal ownership and grants no third-party distribution rights. Concrete external restrictions retain their own source and applicability; absence of a general H04 document is not such a restriction.
internalPolicy.predecessor_scope_retained: H04 evidence evaluation remains exact for operations outside the internal binding, including production, official normative publication and distribution/export. Metadata and matrices do not acquire a new H04 prerequisite.
